quest.title: The Sixth Proposal
quest.description: You run into Kaveh on the streets of Sumeru City. He seems to be embroiled in an argument with a client...

chapter.title: The Pendulum of Weal and Woe

talks.objective: Go to the tavern to look for Kaveh

dialogues.speaker: Badawi
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Were my requests out of line?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something that embodies the creator's efforts and dedication?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Art is something that resonates with the masses?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about looking into another career?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did you decide to become an architect?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do something else and clear your mind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll help you convince the client to come to your side.
